name: MonarchPresenceAvatars
title: PresenceAvatars
wrapsNative: MonarchAvatarGroup (an overlapping HStack) of MonarchAvatar with presence; Button with sheet(isPresented:) and presentationDetents holding a List of everyone
summary: Who is here now: an overlapping stack of avatars with presence dots and a "+N" tile, opening a sheet that lists everyone with their presence and activity.
whenToUse: In the header of a shared document, board or call, to show who else is here now and what they are doing.
whenNotToUse: Not for a static list of assignees or members; use MonarchAvatarGroup. Not for one person's presence; use MonarchAvatar with a status.
api: init(_ people: [MonarchPresencePerson], maxVisible: Int = 4, size: MonarchAvatarSize = .sm, labels: MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels = MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels(), onPersonTap: (@MainActor (MonarchPresencePerson) -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchPresencePerson.init(id: String, name: String, avatarURL: URL? = nil, seed: String? = nil, status: MonarchPresenceStatus = .online, customStatus: String? = nil, activity: String? = nil)

MonarchPresenceAvatarsLabels.init(label: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, showAll: String? = nil, list: String? = nil, done: String? = nil, status: (@Sendable (String, String?) -> String)? = nil, detail: (@Sendable (String, String?) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: people
options.description: Who is here, the most relevant first.

options.name: maxVisible
options.description: Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" tile. With one person more than this, all are shown instead of "+1".

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the avatars in the stack; the presence dot follows it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the stack's name and hint, the list's title and Done button, and the spoken status and second line of a person.

options.name: onPersonTap
options.description: Makes the stack open the list even without hidden people, and each person in the list a button; the sheet closes before it runs.

states.name: all shown
states.description: Every avatar is visible and the stack is not a button; each avatar is read on its own.

states.name: overflow
states.description: A "+N" tile ends the stack and the whole stack is a button that opens the list.

states.name: tappable
states.description: With onPersonTap the stack opens the list and every row in it is a button.

states.name: list open
states.description: A sheet at medium height, resizable to large, lists everyone with avatar, presence dot, name, presence and activity, with a Done button.

appearance: Avatars with a ring in the surface colour and presence dots in their presence colours; the "+N" tile in the muted background with muted text. In the list, names in the default text colour and the second line in the muted text colour, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web opens a popover from the "+N" button and makes each avatar a button. On iOS overlapping 24-point avatars cannot each be a 44-point touch target, so the whole stack is one button that opens a sheet, and people are tapped in that list. On iPad and Mac the sheet appears as a form sheet. Voice Control accepts the initials shown on an avatar through accessibilityInputLabels, where the web adds them to the button's name.
accessibility: The stack is named "5 people here".
A stack that opens the list is one button whose value names each visible person with their presence and activity, then "2 more", with the hint "Shows everyone here".
A stack that does not open the list is a container whose avatars are images named "Ana Silva, Online, Editing".
Presence is always spoken, with the custom status, so it never depends on the dot colour.
Each row in the list is one element with the same text, at least 44 points high, and a button when onPersonTap is given.
Voice Control accepts a person's name or the initials shown on their avatar.
Avatars, dots and text scale with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: An empty list of people draws nothing.
With one person more than maxVisible, every avatar is shown instead of a "+1" tile.
An activity that is empty or white space is left out.
Long names and activities wrap in the list.

examples.title: In a document header
examples.setupTemplate:
private let people = [
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.0.id}}, name: {{people.0.name}}, activity: {{people.0.activity}}),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.1.id}}, name: {{people.1.name}}, activity: {{people.1.activity}}),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.2.id}}, name: {{people.2.name}}, status: Self.status({{people.2.status}})),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.3.id}}, name: {{people.3.name}}, status: Self.status({{people.3.status}}), customStatus: {{people.3.customStatus.emoji}} + " " + {{people.3.customStatus.text}}),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.4.id}}, name: {{people.4.name}}, status: Self.status({{people.4.status}})),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.5.id}}, name: {{people.5.name}}),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: {{people.6.id}}, name: {{people.6.name}}, status: Self.status({{people.6.status}})),
]

private static func status(_ web: String) -> MonarchPresenceStatus {
    switch web {
    case "away": .away
    case "busy": .busy
    case "dnd": .doNotDisturb
    case "offline": .offline
    default: .online
    }
}
examples.setup:
private let people = [
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u1", name: "Priya Raman", activity: "Editing"),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u2", name: "Tom Becker", activity: "Viewing"),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u3", name: "Lee Park", status: Self.status("away")),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u4", name: "Ana Silva", status: Self.status("busy"), customStatus: "📅" + " " + "In a meeting"),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u5", name: "Ben Okafor", status: Self.status("dnd")),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u6", name: "Sam Ito"),
    MonarchPresencePerson(id: "u7", name: "Mia Novak", status: Self.status("offline")),
]

private static func status(_ web: String) -> MonarchPresenceStatus {
    switch web {
    case "away": .away
    case "busy": .busy
    case "dnd": .doNotDisturb
    case "offline": .offline
    default: .online
    }
}
